newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Adare to cut part of Mount Salus business.
newsitem.headline: Adare to cut part of Mount Salus business.

text.p: Ireland's Adare Printing Group Plc said on Friday that following an indepth review of Mount Salus Press Ltd it has decided to withdraw from the flat sheet side of the Mount Salus business.
Adare said in a statement that it had examined the possibility of selling the company to preserve jobs and the business and had received some approaches.
The most serious approach, Adare said, was a management buy-in offer which was presently being considered.

"Regardless of the outcome of these negotiations, the group has decided, in the best interest of its shareholders, to withdraw from the flat sheet side of Mount Salus Press Group and invest in available profitable organic growth opportunities," Adare said.
Adare said it was meeting staff representatives and informing them of the decision, which will be effective from September 15, 1997.
The group said overall demand had been good in the first quarter and it looked forward to the remainder of the year with confidence.
